info.description: A saved 8-bar progression sketch from the Theory → Compose tool. The whole composition (key, tempo, chord spans, melody/bass note spans — all in scale degrees over a 128-tick grid) lives in the `data` JSON field so the composer state round-trips with no flattening. `title` mirrors the composition name for listing.

data.description: The full Composition object: { id, name, key:{root,mode}, bpm, chords[], melody[], bass[] }. Spans use tick units (sixteenth resolution, 128 ticks / 8 bars).
